title: sarcanthus koeteiensis
intro: Sarcanthus koeteiensis, commonly known as the "Sarcanthus" or "Dwarf Sarcanthus", is a species of flowering plant in the family Gesneriaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, aiding in the treatment of various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Sarcanthus koeteiensis include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and act as an expectorant, making it useful in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Sarcanthus koeteiensis include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
